sources.title: Receipt and Cover/CoverNFT state of the CoverBroker product-97 purchase (negative structural fixture)
sources.pin: tx 0x1bec0316a5e23e34d1e81bd81aab8b38333d67e01b01382a112314823edae031 in block 26219867 (hash 0xb72af12b1c4af58497cb4942ed6b0cb5295e33be73d739b76779a8bf50e417fa); captured read-only once on 2026-10-19 from two independent providers (eth.drpc.org, mainnet.gateway.tenderly.co) which returned identical values: transaction, receipt with 11 logs, block, implementation slot keccak256("org.govblocks.proxy.implementation") = 0xcafeafF1a21418f530Feb00C6BAeF07523979C05, code hashes of Broker / Cover proxy / implementation at the block (equal to the pins), getCoverData / getCoverReference / getCoverMetadata / ownerOf at the block for cover 5645; test/fixtures/nexus/buycover-receipt-26219867.json; Cover proxy runtime (863 bytes, keccak256 0xd772ae50e8c6515f53b17b60eb2bf13e0d40ec60cc3d2d5dd8d58d78afb8a1e0, identical to the Sourcify exact-match OwnedUpgradeabilityProxy of CoverProducts 0xcafead81) in test/fixtures/nexus/runtime-cover-proxy-cafeac0f.hex
sources.note: Not a CoverRaccoon purchase: commissionRatio 1000 to a non-zero destination (visible as a USDC transfer from the Broker), empty ipfsData, owner = sender but not a CoverRaccoon intent. Confirms structurally: CoverBought(5645, 5645, 9301, 97) from the Cover proxy (new cover: originalCoverId = coverId; buyer member 9301 = the Broker), CoverNFT mint 0 -> owner of 5645, stored amount 401085049 >= requested 400000000, start = block timestamp, period 2592000. Used only as a negative / structural example, never as a positive receipt.
